answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Every claim climbs the crystal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the oasis re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
